title: FEROS the Fiber-fed Extended Range Optical Spectrograph
what_was_studied: Broad-band high-resolution instrument design and commissioning
numerical_result: FEROS covers roughly 350 to 920 nm at resolving power near 48000
remaining_question: Its broad coverage and stability should not be confused with a dedicated EPRV design

title: FEROS performance and radial-velocity observations
numerical_result: A Tau Ceti sequence showed 8.3 m/s RMS over 245 days in the reported setup
remaining_question: One star and one reduction era cannot define a universal floor

title: CERES automated routines for echelle spectra
what_was_studied: Homogeneous extraction and RV estimation across thirteen spectrographs including FEROS
numerical_result: CERES exposes common reduction steps while retaining instrument-specific modules
remaining_question: Pipeline homogeneity does not erase hardware- and archive-era differences

title: FEROS instrument overview
what_was_studied: Current technical description and calibration modes
numerical_result: ESO states about 25 m/s or better may be possible in Object-Calibration mode and notes that FEROS was not intended as an RV machine
remaining_question: A current observing-call source is still needed to close availability
